description: This PHP source file defines the CellAddress class in the PhpSpreadsheet library. It provides methods for constructing and manipulating cell addresses within a spreadsheet, including handling of worksheet context and coordinate conversions.

classes.name: CellAddress
classes.description: Represents a cell address within a worksheet, supporting address construction, navigation to adjacent cells, and address string generation with worksheet context.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a CellAddress instance from a cell address string and optional worksheet.

methods.name: fullCellAddress
methods.description: Returns the full cell address string, including worksheet name if available.

methods.name: worksheet
methods.description: Returns the Worksheet object associated with the cell address, if set.

methods.name: cellAddress
methods.description: Returns the cell address string without worksheet context.

methods.name: rowId
methods.description: Returns the row index of the cell.

methods.name: columnId
methods.description: Returns the column index of the cell.

methods.name: columnName
methods.description: Returns the column name of the cell.

methods.name: nextRow
methods.description: Returns a new CellAddress object moved to the next row with optional offset.

methods.name: previousRow
methods.description: Returns a new CellAddress object moved to the previous row with optional offset.

methods.name: nextColumn
methods.description: Returns a new CellAddress object moved to the next column with optional offset.

methods.name: previousColumn
methods.description: Returns a new CellAddress object moved to the previous column with optional offset.

methods.name: __toString
methods.description: Returns the string representation of the cell address, including worksheet name if available.
